description: Lava serpent: dark basalt crust plates with a warm rim where they meet the cracks, glowing magma in every crack, hotter flame tips on the fins, crest and tail flick, a white-hot molten core on each segment's gap-facing end and on the lava strands bridging the gaps, a burning maw line and the hottest glow of all in the eyes. Colours authored fresh: the source blend carries no material (only Blender's unused default grey).

crust.note: cooled basalt crust plates (cavity-free; per-face value jitter only)

crust_hot.note: crust rim near a crack - still warm, faint glow

crack.note: magma in the cracks between plates

flame.note: flame-lick tips (fins, crest, tail flick) and the flame tongue

core.note: molten core: each segment's gap-facing end + the lava strands bridging the gaps

maw.note: the open mouth line and cavity
